extension.description: Скрапер метаданных фильмов. Кинопоиск как источник русскоязычных данных, рейтинги Кинопоиска, IMDB, Rotten Tomatoes. Актёры с русскими именами, постеры и фанарт.
Movie metadata scraper. Kinopoisk as the source for Russian-language data, Kinopoisk, IMDB, Rotten Tomatoes ratings. Cast with Russian names, posters and fanart.
extension.news: v3.25.2: Renamed to Kinoscope (from UMS). Key pool refresh on settings change. Full key rotation. Ratings scale normalization. 947 tests.
